name: Kutná Hora: The City of Silver

categories.label: Points accumulated during play
categories.hint: Position of your marker on the score track before final scoring.

categories.label: Kutná Hora: building adjacency
categories.hint: 1 point per matching dot on adjacent buildings or the board edge, for each of your buildings.

categories.label: Mines: row majorities
categories.hint: Per row, rank by stars; points by rank per printed value; ties get full value of the place, no lower place awarded.

categories.label: Income
categories.hint: Final income divided by 10, rounded down.

categories.label: Reputation
categories.hint: Positive or negative points from final positions on reputation tracks.

categories.label: Extras
categories.hint: 1 each: building tile left in a slot on your board, claimed plot without a building, unused pelican token.

categories.label: Groschen left (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Đồng groschen còn lại (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Most groschen left; remaining ties may be settled by jousting or accepted as a draw.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Patrician scoring each round and during play goes into the score track. Rank-based mine points are entered as a total because row values are printed on the board.
